hook: A *500 m* blind bend in Ananthagiri forest gets rumble strips after a crash
hook_b: A *500 m* blind bend in Ananthagiri forest gets rumble strips after a crash
tldr: Four members of a family died when a truck hit their auto on a sharp S-curve in Ananthagiri forest, Vikarabad; officials have recommended safety fixes on the stretch.

beats.what: The crash happened around 9am near Bugga Rameswaram temple on the Vikarabad-Dharur road, when a truck collided with the auto on the curve.
beats.why: Police say the curve runs nearly 500 metres and dense trees block the view of oncoming vehicles.
beats.care: If you ride to Ananthagiri hills on weekends, this interior forest stretch is now flagged accident-prone.

causes.label: Trees block view on a long curve

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Word reached police only around 9.25am because the stretch is deep in the forest; they reached by 9.40am.

cards.q: What would make blind forest curves safest?

qs: Which other ghat or forest roads near Hyderabad lack warning signs?
How quickly are recommended road fixes usually carried out?

facts.t: Police reached the spot about *40 minutes* after the crash in the remote stretch.

steps.e: Truck and auto collide on curve

viz.verdict: A remote stretch where help took 40 minutes to arrive

watch: Whether the recommended trees removal, rumble strips, bollards and signs are installed.
